requirements.quote:
A client MUST NOT send non-probing frames to a preferred address
   prior to validating that address; see Section 8.  This greatly
requirements.condition: Before the client has validated a preferred address
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The client must not send non-probing frames to that preferred address.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can observe frames sent to a preferred address before address validation and fail if any frame is non-probing.
